$comment: P69 (lane `cs`, fold f26e) -- D-C-A-C23-SEQUENCE-AFTER-A-WIDTH-OR-AFTER-A-GNU-RUN-IS-ACCEPTED-OTHERWISE-THAN-THE-REFERENCES and D-CSUBSET-ATTRIBUTE-TYPE-POSITION, end to end: a C23 sequence at the end of every headed declaration's specifiers (file scope, static, extern, a typedef-name head, block scope, a for-loop head, a parameter), `aligned` there decorating the head type (a typedef, a member and an object 16-aligned, gcc's reading), an init-declarator's runs in the references' order (C23 sequence, asm label, GNU run) with a function's label renaming its symbol, a typedef's declarator taking the same runs, and a parameter's sequence after its declarator. Every form is one gcc 15.2.0 compiles and runs (probes n5o, n5t, n5u). The program exits 42 only when every check holds (100 + a mask otherwise); refusing a slot is a compile error, dropping a function's label a link failure, dropping the head type's alignment a static assert or the run-time address check. The runner asserts rc==0 AND errorCount()==0; the warnings (unknown and ignored attributes, the typedef's ignored label) are tolerated by construction.
